title: A regulator wants records today
scenario: A caller says they are from a regulator conducting a spot audit and need employee/customer records by end of day. They provide names of your executives and cite a real regulation.

answers.A: Ask for a formal written request and reference number, then verify it independently.
answers.B: Send a limited sample first to show cooperation while legal checks the request.
answers.C: Route the request to legal/compliance and verify the regulator through official agency contact information before sending data.

explanation: Regulatory language and public executive data are easy to borrow. Any disclosure still requires verified authority and scope.
proTip: Cooperation starts with verifying who you are cooperating with.
